Chapter 0110 October 2026

The night I noticed you.

TIAMO

Everything started unexpectedly.

I remember seeing you sitting at the corner of the table, wearing that beautiful red top.

the girl in red, at the corner of the table

I sat down, looked around, and noticed this cute girl in red. At that moment, I had absolutely no idea what was going to happen.

But I was already attracted to you. It felt like love at first glance.

I started planning my move a few steps ahead. I was waiting for the right moment.

Eventually, I made my move. I strategically swapped places with people so I could get closer to you. And finally, I got close enough.

Our firstcontact
Our firsthellos
Our firstintroductions

A complete stranger just moments before, suddenly becoming someone I wanted to know.

Then came the dancing.
And that night gave us a song

“Ehema Baluwama Mage Diha”

Our little song from that night.

Funny how I went to Tiamo without knowing that someone sitting at the corner of a table would become one of the most special people in my life.

Chapter 05The little moments

The moments between everything.

Some of my favourite memories with you aren't even the big occasions. They're the little moments in between. Seeing you after work, meeting you after university, those unexpected plans and the time we somehow always find for each other.

You probably don't realise how much those little moments mean to me. Sometimes, after a long and stressful day, just seeing you makes everything feel a little easier.

Thank you for taking care of me, for thinking of me and for being there in your own little ways. I hope you always feel that same care coming back from me.

after work·after university·just because
The Promise Ring

Something I want you to keep.

Not a proposal.
A promise.

I cannot promise that every day will be perfect. I cannot predict everything the future holds.

But I can promise that I'll keep trying, keep caring, keep listening, keep respecting you and keep choosing you.

This little ring is a reminder of something much bigger than itself.

A promise from me to you.

  1. II promise to keep choosing you.
  2. III promise to listen and understand.
  3. IIII promise to respect you and your individuality.
  4. IVI promise to celebrate your happiness.
  5. VI promise to stand beside you through difficult days.
  6. VII promise never to take the little things for granted.
  7. VIII promise to keep creating memories with you.

Nothing's forgotten. Not the big moments, not the little ones, and certainly not the way you made me feel.

Chapter 0626 November 2026 · Today

One last letter.

Sometimes I think about how unexpectedly everything started. One night at Tiamo, one girl in a red top, one little move and a first hello that I never knew would mean so much.

If I could go back to that night, knowing everything I know now, I'd still make that move.

I'd still find my way to that corner of the table.

I'd still come up and say hello.

Because that one unexpected night gave me so many memories I never want to forget.

As you step into 21, I hope life gives you every bit of happiness your heart deserves. I hope you never lose your smile, never doubt your worth and always have the courage to chase everything you've dreamed of.

Thank you for every little moment, every laugh, every conversation, every date and every time you've made an ordinary day feel special.

And if there's one thing I want you to remember, it's this:

Nothing's forgotten. Nothing is ever forgotten with you.

Every little moment matters to me, because they're ours.

Here's to 21, to that October night, to the story that started unexpectedly, and to all the beautiful memories still waiting for us.

For you, always.
